description: Purge the fort's nginx page cache (through Bearfort's cache-purge service, the same request WordPress itself makes on content changes), flush the fort's own object-cache keys and reset OPcache. details says 'Page cache: purged', or 'requested' if the purger had not run yet (it runs every 2 s). Needs BEARFORT_API_KEY and Bearfort fleet 2026-10-08.3+ (before that the page cache was not actually purged).

site.description: Site id (see list_sites); must be hosted on Bearfort

name: fort_cache_purge
